apps/gmail: Procedures for the Gmail app (send, find, label, threads, drafts, etc.).
apps/google_drive: Procedures for the Google Drive app (find, upload, move, share files, etc.).
apps/google_sheets: Procedures for the Google Sheets app (rows, lookups, worksheets, updates, etc.).
apps/intercom: Procedures for the Intercom app (contacts, conversations, tickets, tags, notes, etc.).
apps/jira: Procedures for the Jira app (issues, comments, transitions, watchers, attachments, etc.).
apps/salesforce: Procedures for the Salesforce app (records, queries, opportunities, updates, etc.).
apps/slack: Procedures for the Slack app (post messages, channels, users, search, etc.).
domains/finance: Procedures and playbooks for finance-domain tasks (invoices, budgets, reporting, etc.).
domains/hr: Procedures and playbooks for hr-domain tasks (onboarding, reviews, records, etc.).
domains/marketing: Procedures and playbooks for marketing-domain tasks (campaigns, lists, content, etc.).
domains/operations: Procedures and playbooks for operations-domain tasks (logistics, scheduling, tracking, etc.).
domains/sales: Procedures and playbooks for sales-domain tasks (CRM records, pipelines, outreach, etc.).
domains/support: Procedures and playbooks for support-domain tasks (tickets, SLAs, escalations, etc.).
This is the workflow playbook for sales-domain tasks (CRM records, pipelines, outreach, etc.).

This is the operating procedure for the Google Sheets app (rows, lookups, worksheets, updates, etc.).

- Open every worksheet of a spreadsheet (get_spreadsheet_by_id lists them) and read each with get_many_rows; policy/config/updates/blackout tabs override the base rules.
- Write status/label cells using the exact vocabulary in the rules or existing rows.
This is the operating procedure for the Salesforce app (records, queries, opportunities, updates, etc.).

This is the operating procedure for the Slack app (post messages, channels, users, search, etc.).

- Routing rules and process notes are often plain messages in a channel. Call slack_list_channels, then slack_list_channel_messages on the target channel and any ops/policy/rules channel before deciding how to route or what to post.
- In summaries include every required code/ID and the per-item names and amounts you acted on.

This is the operating procedure for the Gmail app (send, find, label, threads, drafts, etc.).

- Policy lives here often: list the inbox broadly (gmail_find_email, no narrow keyword, 50+ results) and read policy/update emails before acting. A narrow keyword search returning nothing does not mean no policy exists; check Slack and Drive next.
- Send one email per recipient when asked to notify each person. Put required tracking codes, IDs and exact source values in the body.
This is the operating procedure for the Google Drive app (find, upload, move, share files, etc.).

messages.text: Wavecrest Analytics asking for a case study. Does anyone have an analytics vertical reference?
Upland Systems ghosted for 3 weeks. Sent breakup email. Sometimes that works 😅
Ironridge is back! After 6 weeks dark they replied to the breakup email. Scheduling a call.
Good news: Alpine Digital signed! 2-year deal, $110k ARR. Nicely done Kevin!
Wavecrest Analytics on boarding call went great. Happy customer — ask for referral?
Q1 close plan: 5 deals in final stage, $620k at risk. Let's align on blockers today.
Anyone have a good champion letter template for manufacturing accounts?
New competitive intel doc posted in #competitive. Ironridge is offering 20% discount to steal accounts.
Anyone have a warm contact at Northstar Media? Need an intro for the media vertical.
Terrace Software close call Friday! Getting the MSA signed before Q1 ends.
CloudBridge Systems is requesting a technical deep-dive on security architecture. Need an SE for March 8
Morning all! Big week ahead — let's close Q1 strong 💪
OOO Wed-Thu for QBR prep. All my accounts covered — ping me if urgent.
Congrats to Megan on closing Thornwood Partners! 🎉 $95k ARR
Riverside Insurance just posted a LinkedIn job for a 'Platform Manager' — good upsell signal!
Meadowbrook Tech rescheduled again — Q2 for sure. Marking as delayed in CRM.
Cascade Analytics came back from procurement — they're asking for net-60 terms
Big W: Bayside Analytics just signed! $85k ARR, 18-month deal. Congrats team! 🥳
Highpoint Consulting wants a custom integration quote. Looping in Solutions team.
PSA: CRM maintenance Saturday 2-4am. Save your work Friday night.
Week 9 leaderboard just posted. Three of us are over 130% — great work everyone!
Oceanfront Labs is doing a PoC. Week 2 check-in call went well — they love the API.
Zenith Platforms contract fully executed ✅ Handing off to CS now.
Who owns the Silverstone Group account? Need to coordinate on renewal timing.
Updated security questionnaire template posted in Google Drive. Check #sales-enablement.
Just got off a call with Harbourview — they want to move to contract this week. Need legal ASAP.
Week 10 starts Monday. Let's sprint to close! Who needs backup on any deals?
Reminder: all deals >$50k need second-level approval. Submit in Salesforce before EOD.
Parkside Solutions: renewal conversation starting. They want a multi-year discount.
Meadowbrook Tech delayed decision to Q2 — board didn't approve new software spend this quarter
Bayside Analytics is evaluating us vs. Competitor X. Request for a third reference call.
Sunstone Capital agreed to a 2-year deal at 8% discount. Checking with VP before countersigning.
Foxridge Capital: verbal yes from the CFO. Contract coming this week!
Terrace Software asked for implementation timeline — sending over SOW template today
Reminder: pipeline review call at 3pm today. Please update your opps before then.
Stonebridge Holdings asked for a multi-year price lock. Escalating to pricing committee.
Standup: Yesterday - Vertex Capital call. Today - Northgate demo. Blocker: legal review taking 2 weeks
Stonebridge Holdings legal review complete — moving to final approval. Should close by Friday.
BlueStar Ventures just signed the NDA — moving to discovery this week
New pricing deck is live — v3.2. All previous versions deprecated, please update your decks.
